title: Sovra Phase 02 Domain Schemas (FTF-0201 — LiteLLM connection CRUD)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the organization-scoped LiteLLM gateway connection resource (Section 2-3/38/65/77/81). Field constraints (patterns, lengths, enums) are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source, apps/api/app/litellm/connection_schema.py, and tested against it directly in tests/tasks/test_ftf_0201.py so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually validates these shapes. LiteLLMConnection (the read-facing/domain-record shape) deliberately has no secret_ref property — this task's own negative_acceptance ('secret echo fails') — while LiteLLMConnectionCreateRequest/LiteLLMConnectionUpdateRequest (write-facing request shapes) do carry it, since the caller must supply it to create/edit a connection; it is simply never echoed back.

SecretRef.description: A secret-manager reference only (vault://, openbao:// or secret://) — never a raw secret value. This task never resolves it to a value; FTF-0202 ('Secret-manager integration') does.

BaseUrl.description: Must be https://, no userinfo, no fragment, no tls_verify=false in the query, no duplicate /v1/v1 path segment (Section 3.1/65.4). Shape-validated only — this task never dials the URL.

LiteLLMConnectionCreateRequest.description: The create request body — carries secret_ref, since the caller must supply it.

LiteLLMConnection.description: Section 2-3/38/65/77/81 — the read-facing representation. Deliberately has NO secret_ref property (this task's own negative_acceptance: 'secret echo fails'); additionalProperties: false makes a leaked secret_ref a contract violation, not merely an undocumented extra field.
